flagged.evidence: The proof defines row_i(pi star T) = row_{pi_j(i)}(T) and calls this a left action. For this formula, row_i(pi1 star (pi2 star T)) = row_{pi2(pi1(i))}(T), which corresponds to pi2 pi1, not pi1 pi2 under the repository's left-action convention (the dependency def-young-subgroup-tabloid-and-permutation-module states sigma dot (tau dot {t}) = (sigma tau) dot {t}). The maps still give the stated free orbits, so this is a harmless left/right action mislabel.

The proof says equal row images imply gamma = delta because the row sets partition the labels. The dependency def-young-subgroup-tabloid-and-permutation-module defines tabloids by row sets; equality of images of each row set implies only that delta^{-1} gamma preserves each row. For example, on row sets {1,2} and {3}, the identity and (12) have the same images of both row sets but are distinct. The column-stabilizer conditions may establish the claimed uniqueness, but no argument using them is given before the support-intersection equality is used to count the pairing.
